scope: Exactly review-delta-1.json, 53 already held Latin/English source pairs. This approves only the proposed source-cue/family mapping; it does not alter literal source text, supply source approval, authorize another witness, or approve runtime activation.

source_images_read.locus: Lasance1945 PDF818, printed819; all five Latin/English conclusions and separately marked Amen

runtime_preconditions_not_tested_here: Exact roman-1962 edition, source-owner target, language and explicitly selected witness must match; no cross-recension or cross-witness inheritance.
Current literal body, binding, complete Latin proof, formula table and reviewed per-row identity must all match their pins.

A full conclusion is executed only for the actually final prayer in its applicable conclusion group; a nonfinal shared prayer retains source quotation separately and receives no duplicated conclusion or Amen.
The source-proved seat and RGMR442-443 multiple-lesson placement remain controlling for Ember Days; main form and name Collect alone do not establish placement.
The final group member supplies its own family; no reuse of the principal prayer family for a later commemoration.
The table has a separately marked response Amen; do not silently make it priest formula text.
Preserve quotation separately from source-derived execution and retain source credit; this is neither official English nor a claim that the target prints expanded wording.

specific_review_observations.finding: The spiritual growth of the Church and English of the spirit are not an explicit invocation or mention of the Holy Spirit. The attested through-our-Lord family remains.
Spirituali poculo describes the spiritual cup; it is not Spiritus Sancti. No same-Spirit suffix is inferred.

Both source cues explicitly appoint through-the-same despite the Son reference within the last clause about His Mother. Preserve the attested family, rather than choosing who-with-thee solely from a last-word heuristic.
The prayer invokes the Mother of God and both source cues specify through-the-same. The named family is followed; no anonymous default is invented.
